sql: select count(*) from anchor_receipts r join anchor_batches b on b.id = r.batch_id where r.status = 'da_gui' and r.provider = 'opentimestamps' and r.calendar = 'https://cal-b.test' and r.created_by = 'agent:anchor' and substr(r.receipt, 1, 33) = decode('004f70656e54696d657374616d7073000050726f6f6600bf89e2e884e892940108', 'hex') and substr(r.receipt, 34, 32) = decode(b.manifest_sha256, 'hex') and position(decode('83dfe30d2ef90c8e', 'hex') in r.receipt) > 0
select count(*) from anchor_receipts where status = 'loi'
